description: This file defines the class FilterJars, which implements the JarScanFilter interface to determine whether certain JAR files should be scanned, based on properties set in the configuration.

classes.name: FilterJars
classes.description: A filter class implementing the JarScanFilter interface to include or exclude specific JAR files during scanning based on a configuration property.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Determines if a JAR file should be scanned based on the JarScanType and JAR name, utilizing a property 'webSocket' in the 'catalina' configuration.
